data_description.hold_connection: Keep the Bluetooth connection to this fan open permanently, so commands respond in about 0.2 s instead of waiting 2-6 s for a fresh connection. While held, the fan occupies one of the three connection slots on whichever ESPHome Bluetooth proxy carries it, and the AC Infinity phone app cannot connect to the fan. Turn this off to go back to connecting only for each command and poll.
data_description.preferred_proxy: Route this fan's Bluetooth connection through one named ESPHome proxy whenever it can see the fan, instead of whichever proxy Home Assistant's signal-strength scorer would otherwise pick on every reconnect. Falls back to that normal routing after a few failed attempts through the named proxy, so a proxy that goes offline never strands the fan. Automatic (the default) leaves routing entirely to Home Assistant.
data_description.thermostat: The thermostat that runs the HVAC blower this vent sits on. It tells the vent when the blower is moving air, so the vent can run at its circulation speed then and rest otherwise, and when cooling or heating is running, so the vent can measure how cold or warm its air is. Leave empty to use the rest speed at all times.

device_unreachable.title: {name} has had no Bluetooth link for {minutes}+ minutes
device_unreachable.description: Home Assistant has not been able to hold a Bluetooth connection to {name} for {minutes} minutes. The usual causes are that the fan has lost power, or that no Bluetooth proxy near it is online. This repair clears itself as soon as the connection is back.

release_link.name: Release link
release_link.description: Cleanly drops the Bluetooth link this integration holds to every configured fan, then re-establishes it after a delay. Call this immediately before restarting Home Assistant: Home Assistant tears its Bluetooth stack down while integrations are still releasing, so a restart leaves the fan believing it is still connected and it stops advertising until its proxy is rebooted.

resume_after.name: Resume after
resume_after.description: Seconds to wait before rebuilding the link if Home Assistant is still running. Protects against a restart that never happens; 0 leaves the link released.
